findings.title: Acceptance and publication disagree on binary sides
findings.scenario: The publisher now accepts a side value the frozen comparison never produces for a binary file.
findings.consequence: A finding on a binary file is accepted here and then refused at publication, turning the run into an attention state instead of a review.
findings.action: Refuse the side at acceptance so the contract violation surfaces where it can be explained.
findings.explanation: Acceptance and publication disagree about which sides a binary file can carry.
